mentions.name: Chess engine
mentions.description: A chess engine under development, revived after the author delegated tedious implementation busywork to a coding agent, with the hope of eventually coding it manually.
mentions.source_excerpt: Retook Chess Engine development, got unstuck by letting the agent do the boring busywork, I wish I would have done it without, but I don't have the greatest work ethic, hopefully one day I will manually code it.
